svg.title: System map of the AI contact center
svg.desc: Callers reach a SIP trunk and Asterisk, join a LiveKit room, and talk to an agent that listens, thinks and speaks. The agent reaches memory, clinical systems and guardrails. Every call is traced in Langfuse and scored by an LLM judge.
